completion_decisions: Retain traditional PSO and the strict-noise and economic-compensation problems as the target paper-paired contribution.
Omit unchanged IA-PSO because the target explicitly uses it only as a calculation-time comparison baseline.
Digitize the 80 plotted reference coordinates and the 12-direction by five-speed Figure-5 wind rose.
Retain partial Jensen/linear wakes, DTU 10 MW MPPT power, Hubbard two-mechanism noise, octave A weighting, spatial maximum L10, 4D spacing, 45 dBA and 10000 kWh/dBA.
Use declared DTU control/noise constants, a 5 by 5 observation grid, and calibrate only unavailable wind/noise constants to the published reference-layout anchors.
Complete the paper's unquantified limited slight-noise range with its stated 50 dBA recommended upper value while compensation begins at 45 dBA.
Use population 100, c1=c2=2, a 10-percent velocity bound, reference-centred initialization, 4D repair and the paper's exact 200 updates.
Parallelize particle evaluation/update with one persistent C++ worker team, SIMD evaluator reductions, counter-keyed events and ordered best commits.
Run ten repeats per paper case on Waffle after H6 admission.

paper.authors: Xiawei Wu and Weihao Hu and Qi Huang and Cong Chen and Mark Z. Jacobson and Zhe Chen
paper.title: Optimizing the Layout of Onshore Wind Farms to Minimize Noise

paper_source_conflicts: The paper calls FINO3 the reference wind farm although FINO3 is an offshore research platform and this problem is framed as onshore.
The printed A-weighting expression uses natural-log typography although acoustic decibel accumulation requires base-10 logarithms.

scope.claim_boundary: academic flexible reconstruction of traditional PSO and both paper-native noise-layout problems; not author code, native wind/layout/noise arrays, IA-PSO, random stream, or exact numerical optimum replay

constraints_and_repair.resolution: rectangular bounds, 4D spacing, 45 dBA strict threshold, 45--50 dBA compensated acceptance range, finite 1000000 hard-constraint penalty and deterministic 4D repair

decision_variables.resolution: continuous x/y coordinates for 80 DTU 10 MW turbines, 160 dimensions

encoding_and_decoder.resolution: direct double coordinate vector with Figure-4 digitized reference layout

initialization.resolution: reference or strict-zone displaced incumbent, reference-centred normal particles, bounded velocities and deterministic spacing repair

metrics_and_repeats.resolution: annual energy, maximum observation-zone L10, excess noise, spacing, objective, physical FES, timings, worker receipt and hash; ten trials per case

objective_and_direction.resolution: maximize annual energy under strict noise, or annual energy less 0.01 GWh per excess dBA under economic compensation

paper_native_cases.resolution: Case A strict noise control and Case B economically compensated noise control are separately registered

parameters.resolution: 200 updates, population 100, c1=c2=2, no added inertia term and 10-percent velocity bound

stopping_and_physical_fes.resolution: exactly 200 updates; each complete 80-turbine 60-state wake/power/noise/L10/constraint evaluation is one FES; 20100 FES per run

training_and_inference_lifecycle.resolution: T78 traditional PSO has no trained model

update_order.resolution: simultaneous paper-equation velocity/position update, per-particle spacing repair, parallel evaluation and ordered personal/global-best commit

wake_power_cost_or_coupled_model.resolution: partial-overlap Jensen/linear deficits, DTU 10 MW MPPT, two Hubbard mechanisms, octave A weighting, logarithmic source accumulation and probability-weighted spatial-maximum L10

wind_and_scenario_sampling.resolution: normalized digitization of 12 direction sectors and five speed bands into 60 weighted states
